metadata.title: 10 Major Public Universities in Bangladesh
metadata.ranking_note: This is a practical selection of 10 major public universities, not an official ranking.
metadata.cost_definition: Indicative total academic cost for completing an undergraduate degree. This is a broad planning estimate, not an official fee quotation.
cost_exclusions: Retake, improvement and special examination fees unless included in a university's published schedule
metadata.important_cost_warning: Public university fees are subsidized and usually much lower than private university fees. However, exact payable amounts differ by admission session, department, credit load, hall status, lab/studio charges and university notices. Department-level figures in this file are approximate planning ranges, not verified official totals. Contact the university and check its latest admission circular and fee schedule before relying on them.
metadata.department_note: The department lists are representative undergraduate options, not a complete catalogue of every department, institute or programme.
